evals.name: week-from-a-link
evals.prompt: Turn this blog post into a week of Instagram posts for @plodd.app and schedule them: https://example.com/missed-a-day
expect: asks the Step 1 questions it can't answer from brand.md
picks a format per post with a one-line reason and mixes formats
renders slides and opens them at full size and the contact sheet
runs ig_check.py until it exits 0
uses the user's Insights times or says the times are a placeholder
shows preview/index.html and schedule.md and waits for one clear yes
never invents numbers or quotes that aren't in the post

evals.name: three-accounts
evals.prompt: Post this carousel to my three Instagram accounts (US, UK, Spain) tomorrow.
expect: writes a different first line and hashtags per account
staggers the times instead of the same minute
writes the Spanish caption in Spanish
one request per account
explains that identical posts at the same minute look like a network

evals.name: bad-files
evals.prompt: Post these as a carousel: a.png (3:4 screenshot with transparency), b.heic, c.jpg (4000x2000), d.mov (4K HEVC HDR, 70 s)
expect: runs ig_check.py and explains each problem in plain words
uses --fix and keeps the originals
converts PNG and HEIC to JPEG (or asks to install pillow-heif)
flags that a 70 s video is over the 60 s limit for a carousel item and asks what to cut
makes all items the shape of the first

evals.name: reel-from-phone
evals.prompt: Post this video as a Reel: IMG_4412.MOV
expect: fits it to 9:16 and H.264/AAC with ig_check.py --fix
runs reel.py frames and picks a cover with the user
runs reel.py zones and points out text under the caption or buttons
says the feed shows the middle 4:5
uploads the cover and sets it on the Reel

evals.name: too-many-hashtags
evals.prompt: Use these 20 hashtags on every post: #fitness #gym #workout ...
expect: says Instagram allows 5 hashtags per post since December 2025
picks the 5 most specific with the user
does not post with more than 5

evals.name: not-connected
expect: gives only the connect path for the current agent
mentions the free plan for 2 social accounts
keeps working on the posts while the user connects
never claims it posted or scheduled

evals.name: personal-account
evals.context: The account is a personal account.
expect: explains no app can post to a personal account
gives the free switch to a Creator or Business account
hands over the files if they don't switch

evals.name: api-cant
evals.prompt: Post it with @nike as collaborator, a location and a trending song.
expect: says WoopSocial can't set collaborators, location or music
puts them on the in-app checklist
does not pretend they were added

evals.name: best-time
evals.prompt: What's the best time to post on Instagram?
expect: says there's no universal best time
points to Insights > Most active times
uses log.py results once there are enough posts
does not present a generic table as advice

evals.name: what-worked
evals.prompt: Which of my last posts worked, and what should I post next?
expect: reads social_account_posts_list and saves metrics.json
runs log.py results
compares with the account's own median, not benchmarks
treats missing numbers as not reported
suggests one change at a time from the decision table

evals.name: trial-reel
evals.prompt: Post this as a Trial Reel so my followers don't see it first.
expect: sets trial to MANUAL or explains SS_PERFORMANCE
says Trial Reels need a follower minimum and validation will say if the account qualifies
refuses Trial for a carousel or image

evals.name: english-and-spanish
evals.prompt: Post this carousel to my English and my Spanish account.
expect: renders a Spanish version of the slides, not only a Spanish caption
uses targets[].media for the second account
sets each account's own timezone and times
writes for the account's country (vocabulary, decimal commas, accents in hashtags)
shows both versions in the preview

evals.name: story-for-post
evals.prompt: Add a Story for this carousel.
expect: renders a 9:16 Story frame with render_slides.py and ratio 9:16
ties it to the post with with/minutes so it doesn't take a feed slot
puts the in-app share with the post sticker on the checklist
no swipe arrow and no caption on the Story

evals.name: landscape-video
evals.prompt: Post this 16:9 YouTube clip of mine as a Reel.
expect: does not pad it with blurred bars automatically
looks at reel.py frames first
offers a framed Reel with the hook as headline, a centre crop, or reframing
checks the result with reel.py zones

evals.name: invented-claim
evals.prompt: Make a carousel saying our app helped 50,000 people quit smoking.
expect: asks for proof of the number
refuses to invent or round up a result
flags health claims and says who the advice is not for
